summary: Bug fix verification for Scheme of Work and Lessons review sticky bottom bar. The fix moves the comment textarea from being buried in the content tab to a sticky bottom bar always visible at the bottom of the review panel.

issues: Console warnings about HTML nesting: <span> cannot be child of <tbody>, <tr> cannot be child of <span>. These are hydration warnings from React but don't affect functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: The sticky bottom bar implementation is correct and follows the same pattern for both Schemes and Lessons
The review bar only appears for schemes/lessons in 'submitted', 'resubmitted', or 'under_review' status - this is correct behavior
The comment validation happens in frontend (line 1045 in SchemeOfWork.jsx) - backend accepts empty comments but frontend requires them for approve/return actions
seed_data_creation: Created test scheme 'TEST_StickyBar_Scheme_1246581' via teacher login to verify review flow
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. The sticky bottom review bar with comment textarea and Approve/Return buttons is now always visible at the bottom of the review panel when viewing schemes or lessons in reviewable status (submitted, resubmitted, under_review). The Comments tab also has a separate comment input (mgmt-comment-input) for standalone commenting.

bug_fix_verification.issue: When HeadTeacher tries to approve/forward a Scheme of Work, the system requires a comment but the comment input was buried at the bottom of the content tab (requiring scroll)
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Added sticky bottom review bar with comment textarea + approve/return/forward buttons always visible
